facts.claim: A Yemenia Airbus A320-200, registration 7O-AFB, was performing flight IY-648 from Aden to Amman.
On approach to Amman, the aircraft flew through hail and then continued for a landing on runway 26L without further incident.
The aircraft was still on the ground in Amman about 29 hours after landing.

zh.title: 葉門航空A320飛往安曼途中遭遇冰雹，降落26L跑道後仍停場約29小時
zh.summary: 葉門航空A320執行IY-648航班由亞丁飛往安曼時，在進場安曼途中遭遇冰雹，隨後降落26L跑道且未再發生進一步事件；飛機在落地約29小時後仍停留在安曼。
body: 葉門航空一架空中巴士A320-200客機、註冊編號7O-AFB，執行IY-648航班由亞丁飛往安曼，在進場安曼時遭遇冰雹。飛機隨後降落26L跑道，且未再發生進一步事件。
報導指出，飛機在落地約29小時後仍停留在安曼；除停場時間外，報導未進一步說明飛機損傷或後續處置情形。

en.title: Yemenia A320 lands at Amman after flying through hail on approach
en.summary: A Yemenia Airbus A320 operating flight IY-648 from Aden to Amman flew through hail on approach to Amman, then continued to a landing on runway 26L without further incident; the aircraft was still on the ground in Amman about 29 hours after landing.
body: A Yemenia Airbus A320-200, registration 7O-AFB, performing flight IY-648 from Aden (Yemen) to Amman (Jordan), was on approach to Amman when the aircraft flew through hail. The aircraft continued for a landing on runway 26L without further incident.
The aircraft was still on the ground in Amman about 29 hours after landing, according to the report, which gives no further detail on damage or next steps beyond the time on the ground.
